CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillC.en: BILL has lots of POKéMON!\nHe collects rare ones, too!
CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillC.fr: BILL a plein de POKéMON !\nIl collectionne aussi les rares !

CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillD.en: That BILL!\pI heard that he'll do whatever it\ntakes to get rare POKéMON.\pHe's not above doing all sorts\nof things, I've heard.
CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillD.fr: Ce BILL !\pJ'ai entendu dire qu'il ferait\nn'importe quoi pour avoir des\pPOKéMON rares.\pIl est capable de bien des choses,\nparaît-il.

CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Every.en: Have you heard about BILL?\pEveryone calls him a POKéMANIAC!\pI think people are just jealous of\nBILL, though.\pWho wouldn't want to boast about\ntheir POKéMON?
CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Every.fr:
Tu as entendu parler de BILL ?\pTout le monde l'appelle un
POKéMANIAC !\pJe crois que les gens sont juste
jaloux de BILL.\pQui ne voudrait pas se vanter de
ses POKéMON ?

CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TryTr.en:
Why don't you go upstairs and try
trading POKéMON with your friends?\pYou could get a lot more variety
by trading.\pThe POKéMON you get in trades grow
quickly, too.
CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TryTr.fr:
Va donc à l'étage échanger des
POKéMON avec tes amis !\pTu pourrais avoir bien plus de
variété en échangeant.\pLes POKéMON reçus par échange
grandissent vite aussi.
